notes: מֵעֶקְרוֹן וְעַד־גַּת writes a conjunction immediately before the limit preposition, so the two English words even unto answer to two morphemes: the waw takes even and עַד takes unto, exactly as rule 16 divides וְעַד־בַּעַל גָּד.
s009 is the preposition אֵת (H854), not the object marker, and fuses with מִן as a compound preposition headed on the governing morpheme standing first (rules 16, 23).
